title: Cover Crop Effect on Soil Water
transcription_check: Tables 1–3 visually checked against PDF pages 2–3 on 2026-11-15; one analyst, not an independent double extraction
design: Alternating paired strips, four replications of each treatment on each farm. Random allocation is not established by the report. Raw replicate yields and sensor time series were not acquired.

farms.soil_water_pattern: Drier in June; wetter beginning mid-July through late season
Drier under cover during the reported summer sensor period

source_conflicts: Brown cover seeding is October 4 in Table 1 and October 14 in Table 2.
Gustafson termination is May 31 in Table 1 and May 22 in Table 2; this changes before/after soybean planting classification.
Lehman termination is May 21 in Table 1 and May 19 in Table 2.
The conclusion's Ose no-yield-effect statement conflicts with Table 3 and the Results, which report a significant 11 bu/ac corn reduction. Retain Table 3 values and flag the contradiction.
Cannon's rounded difference and LSD both equal 1 bu/ac while the table marks significance. Retain the author's label; rounded summaries cannot recreate the original test.
excluded_inferences: No positive saving in irrigation or ET inferred from soil moisture
Nonsignificance is not proof of equivalence
No new p-values or confidence intervals from unavailable raw strips
No prescription of chemical products or termination timing
No raw field-level simulation or current profit validation
